rhythm: ask → pull 1–3 records → update theory → next ask

acts.title: Both claims look real
acts.dna_beat: cold open + records as conflicting witnesses

loops.ask: What does each woman assert about the same soldier?
loops.theory_update: Two sincere-looking widow files; different marriage dates and different asserted deaths.
loops.payoff: Stakes: this is an open dispute, not a family-history chapter.

loops.ask: Can both marriages be verified as recorded events?
loops.theory_update: 1858 Ripley Corbett/Ashby and 1866 Jefferson Corbett/Briggs (groom: widower) both exist on paper.
loops.payoff: This isn’t a clerical mix-up. Two real wedding papers.

acts.title: The war paper splits
acts.dna_beat: escalating reveal — you thought you knew how he died

loops.ask: What happened to Martha’s household after the war?
loops.teaching_side: D017 (Harriet remarriage) optional — teaches pension remarriage rule without being Martha
loops.theory_update: Martha remains Corbett widow-head in Ripley; children continuous; no remarriage on census.
loops.payoff: Martha’s file isn’t abandoned; she lives as a soldier’s widow.

loops.ask: What do the military papers say about Elias’s wartime fate?

decoy_branch.handle: Silas M. Corbit — eliminate by Co. B 83rd Indiana, Dearborn residence, age ≠ Elias; he DID die. Do not conflate with D007.

loops.theory_update: Hospital line (D007): dead of disease ~1863-11-12. Muster (D008): Eli Corbett deserted / missing — supposed dead after leaving convalescence. Records disagree.
loops.payoff: You thought you knew how he died. The muster doesn’t agree with the hospital line.

acts.player_moment: The war paper doesn’t agree with itself.

acts.title: He’s alive in the paper
acts.dna_beat: escalating reveal — dead soldier in census with another wife

loops.identity_bridge: Same man cluster: age band, Jefferson, Lydia + children matching D003, continuity from D006 widower ceremony
loops.noise_handling: Corbit/Eli/age-off/Wife are ordinary record noise — never labeled clues
loops.theory_update: Postwar Jefferson censuses show Elias/Eli with Lydia as Wife and their children — after the hospital ‘death’ line.
loops.payoff: The ‘dead’ soldier is in the census with another wife.

loops.ask: Does death naming reinforce Lydia’s domestic standing?
loops.theory_update: 1887 death/burial name Lydia — strong for household standing, not yet decisive for marriage law.
loops.payoff: Death paper backs Lydia’s lived claim (primacy trap still live).

acts.act_payoff: Postwar life with Lydia is real on paper.
acts.player_moment: He’s in the census with the second wife.

acts.title: Adjudication
acts.dna_beat: death certificate isn’t the marriage law

decoy_branch.handle: Eli Corbin & Martha Ann Ashley divorce 1865 — surname mismatches Corbin≠Corbett, Ashley≠Ashby must stay readable. Not our couple. Return to D014 negative.

loops.theory_update: No divorce/dissolution for Elias+Martha in supplied Ripley+Jefferson search.

loops.ask: Weigh named widow on death paper vs undissolved prior marriage
loops.theory_update: Ceremony real; widower status on D006 false given living undissolved prior spouse; Lydia domestically true, legally secondary.
loops.payoff: The death certificate isn’t the marriage law.

loops.ask: Adjudicate supportable widow + why both claims look real

commit.B_claimant_beliefs: Martha: wartime death word + true 1858 marriage. Lydia: told first wife died of fever + true ceremony + death naming her.
commit.C_what_happened: Desertion after conflicting dead paper; lived with Lydia until 1887 death.
commit.D_why_both_look_real: Martha backed by early marriage + children + no divorce; Lydia backed by long cohabitation + ceremony + death paper — without collapsing record-says into happened.

loops.payoff: Martha supportable; Lydia’s file domestically true and legally secondary.

acts.player_moment: The death certificate isn’t the marriage law.

acts.title: Satisfying ending (not a cliffhanger)

loops.theory_update: Brother’s affidavit confirms desertion knowledge + lie to Lydia. Color/motive only.
loops.payoff: This case resolves cleanly. Sealed deepens motive; does not reopen a new mystery.
loops.player_moment: I finished — and I want the next case.

acts.act_payoff: Case closed; series appetite from craft/tone.

Treat D006 ceremony as proof of lawful marriage
Treat one of D007/D008 as definitive without the conflict + postwar life
Merge Silas D015 into Elias identity
